newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Cerj sold for 605.3 mln reais.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Cerj sold for 605.3 mln reais.

text.p: Rio de Janeiro power firm Cerj has been auctioned for 605.3 million reais to a consortium that includes Spanish firm Endesa SA and Portugal's Eletricidade de Portugal (EDP), the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange (BVRJ) said.
Rio de Janeiro state, which had a 70.8 percent stake in Cerj, sold a 70.2 percent stake at today's privatization auction, which opened at a minimum price of 464.7 million reais.
The group is led by Chile's Chilectra, the distribution unit of Chile's Enersis.
The remaining 7.8 percent is being sold to Cerj employees with a 30 percent discount on the minimum price, which was set at 640 million reais for Cerj's total share capital.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro Newsroom, 55-21-5074151
